Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4. indication_label contains 'infection' (case-insensitive). Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind ascending.
